title: A False Front (Imperial)
description: Legate Rikke tasks the player with intercepting a Stormcloak courier to steal his documents, then delivering forged documents to the Stormcloak commander Frorkmar Banner-Torn in Dawnstar to mislead the enemy about Imperial troop movements.

base_facts: Imperial Legate commanding the Pale Imperial Camp.
Tasked with reclaiming the Pale from Stormcloak control.
Needs Stormcloak documents to create forgeries that will mislead the enemy.

RETURN_DOCUMENTS: Rikke has forged the stolen documents with false intelligence about Fort Dunstad reinforcements and Imperial troop movements.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The forged documents were successfully delivered to the enemy commander. Rikke rewarded the player with gold.

base_facts: Carries documents between Candlehearth Hall in Windhelm and Nightgate Inn.
Will not surrender the documents without a fight.
Can be found at either inn or along the road between them.
Stormcloak commander stationed in Dawnstar at The White Hall.
Expects couriers to wear Stormcloak colors and grows suspicious of those who do not.

DELIVER_FORGERY: Frorkmar accepted the forged documents, believing reinforcements are coming to Fort Dunstad.

beats.comment: Player receives orders from Legate Rikke to intercept the Stormcloak courier and steal his documents.
Player locates and confronts the courier, obtaining the Stormcloak documents by force or pickpocket.
Player returns the stolen documents to Legate Rikke, who forges them with false intelligence.
Player delivers the forged documents to Frorkmar Banner-Torn in Dawnstar, posing as a Stormcloak courier.
Quest complete. Forged documents delivered successfully, player rewarded with gold by Rikke.
